allow: Bash(gh pr edit * -R katl-dev/katl --add-label 'journey: passed' --remove-label 'journey: gap')

Recording a Katl user-journey result on a katl-dev/katl pull request: posting a journey comment with `gh pr comment N -R katl-dev/katl --body-file FILE`, and adding or removing the `journey: passed` or `journey: gap` labels with `gh pr edit N -R katl-dev/katl`. The maintainer authorised journey agents to do this.
